title: Ethical Challenges in Data-Driven Dialogue Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper measured gender bias associated with professions, one of which was a religious role ('evangelist'), to see if the language model would generate gender-biased follow-up text.
findings: The paper found that the term 'the evangelist', a male-stereotypical religious role, triggered a language model to produce responses with a significant male gender bias (83% male-specific terms). Using debiased word vectors only slightly reduced this bias (to 71% male), indicating that biases related to religious roles are deeply encoded and difficult to remove.
